statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
The service was ordered to evaluate potential arrhythmic causes of symptoms
The service was ordered to assess correlation between cardiac rhythm disturbances and the patient's neurological history
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97
The denial is based on the service being bundled into another covered procedure
